title: Choose the visual world for Klora Fitness
question: Pink pastel is pinned. The roll assigned The Program Card. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Program Card
options.lineage: a PT's clipboard program sheets, sticky tabs and highlighters
options.thesis: Every screen is a sheet off her clipboard: ruled set grids, a pink highlighter for today, a coloured tab per client.
options.viewport: Today's session as one sheet: a big hand-numbered set grid, the current row washed in highlighter pink, Start pinned low.
options.risk: Goes twee if the stationery is drawn literally instead of as a strict grid system.

raised.raise: States are printed marks: hairline set at rest, filled when logged, struck through with a pen line when done.
A strict hairline module system with small header tabs, so the trainer roster packs a whole client book onto one screen.
A client whose status changed (new check-in, missed week) stays highlighted until she has seen it.
One hot pink is reserved for 'now / needs you' and means nothing else anywhere.

options.label: The Pastel Dumbbell Rack
options.lineage: coated neoprene hand-weights racked by colour
options.thesis: Load is colour: pink, lilac, mint, butter tiers like a dumbbell rack, in soft rounded vinyl.
options.viewport: A rack of rounded load chips across the top, today's lifts as big soft pills beneath.
options.risk: Familiar: candy-pastel fitness apps are the look most runs land on for this brief.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.lineage: airport pass segments and departure boards
options.thesis: Clients ranked like departures; changes stay lit.
options.viewport: A board of clients ordered by next session.
options.risk: Travel metaphor; clients would not recognise it.
options.case: Fuses well for the roster, poorly for logging a set.
options.kept: Changed rows hold their highlight until seen.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Each client a coloured line through their programme.
options.viewport: A line map of a client's training blocks.
options.risk: Midnight ground contradicts the pinned pink pastel.
options.case: Loses both axes against the brief.
options.kept: Declined without a raise: its discipline is already carried by the program grid.

options.label: Japanese High-Density Web
options.thesis: Tiny type, boxed modules, utility tabs.
options.viewport: A mosaic of ruled client modules.
options.risk: Too dense for a client mid-set.
options.case: Strong for the trainer desk, wrong for the gym floor.
options.kept: Hairline module system with small header tabs.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.thesis: Twin columns around a rail of keys.
options.viewport: Two columns of sets around a rail.
options.risk: Bookish; no one reads a workout like an edition.
options.kept: States as printed marks: hairline, filled, struck.

options.label: Vertical Video Feed
options.thesis: One exercise owns the viewport, next one a flick away.
options.viewport: The current exercise GIF full-screen with a right rail.
options.risk: Media-first; most of the app is lists and numbers.
options.case: The app already has a focus view that does this.
options.kept: Already present in the focus workout view; no new raise.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.thesis: Translucent sheets, a zone ramp, one magenta.
options.risk: Darkroom world is foreign to her clients.
options.kept: One reserved hue that only ever means one thing.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white fitness app with rounded cards, a pink accent and a bottom tab bar, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Greeting, today's workout card, weekly rings, tab bar.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other fitness app by design.
